---
title: "Chat with me"
---

Here you can chat with a digital version of me. It knows my background, my
writing and my data science projects, and it answers right away.

This page is in **English** so the site is also useful to people who don't read Danish.

One more thing: I can look over the shoulder of my digital twin and step in. (You can tell from the color of the photo's border if it's me and not the twin.)

::: {.column-screen}
<div class="avatar-embed">
  <iframe
    id="avatar-iframe"
    src=""
    title="Digital twin of Lasse Hjorth Madsen"
    allow="clipboard-write"
  ></iframe>
</div>
:::

```{=html}
<style>
  /* The app supplies its own chrome and centres its chat on the same column
     width as this site, so it needs no frame of its own here. */
  .avatar-embed { overflow-x: hidden; }
  .avatar-embed iframe {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 85vh;
    min-height: 540px;   /* keeps it usable on a phone in landscape */
    border: none;
  }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var BASE = "https://avatar.tekstogtal.dk";

  // Forward ?q=N from this page into the iframe, so a link like
  // tekstogtal.dk/avatar.html?q=2 opens the page and answers Q2 on arrival.
  var q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("q");
  document.getElementById("avatar-iframe").src =
    BASE + (q ? "/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q) : "/");
})();
</script>
```
